summary_en: Upper limit raised from ¥3.0B to ¥5.0B; share count increased from 900,000 (2.58% S/O) to 1,300,000 (3.79% S/O); acquisition period extended from 30-Jun-2026 to 30-Nov-2026. Method: open-market purchase. Cumulative to 31-May-2026: 601,500 shares, ¥2.519B acquired.
title_en: Notice of amendment to terms regarding treasury share acquisition under the Articles of Incorporation (acquisition of treasury shares per Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On 5 June 2026, the board of directors approved an amendment to the treasury share acquisition program initially authorized on 5 December 2025. The program's upper limit for share purchases was increased from 900,000 shares (2.58% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) to 1,300,000 shares (3.79% of issued shares excluding treasury stock). The authorized acquisition budget was simultaneously raised from ¥3.0 billion to ¥5.0 billion. The acquisition method remains open-market purchase on the exchanges. The execution window has been extended from 8 December 2025 – 30 June 2026 to 8 December 2025 – 30 November 2026 on a trade-date basis. By 31 May 2026, the company had acquired 601,500 shares for ¥2.519 billion under the original authorization. The stated purpose is to facilitate flexible capital allocation and further enhance shareholder returns.
